e1547c9d0db5715c.description: The role of the “Technical Manager” is to be responsible for all technical requirements for all typologies Attraction rides and devices within the complex. Thise role will involve active participation during Detailed Design stage through to ride and device installation onsite, working alongside consultants & manufacturers, aiming to implement SEVEN’s maintenance requirements, processes & technical pre & post opening requirements, ensuring operational readiness. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Managerial & Strategic Responsibilities Active collaboration with operation & project attraction team and several project management consultants. Close communication with ride manufacturers engaged with the SEVEN portfolio. Deal with best international safety practices and local authorities’ regulators in KSA. Manage the technical requirements of rides/devices during their implementation. Core Responsibilities Work closely with SEVEN’s Operation & Project Attraction team to support the maintenance strategy in line with the business operation plan of each complex. Review and comment on Concept, Schematic, and Detail Design package reports in alliance with SEVEN’s Project Strategy and protocols. Evaluate local and international market opportunities, including contractors, specialist suppliers, service providers, certified spare parts distributors, and trading companies. Work closely with the QHSE team in the development and implementation of ISO systems and certifications. Develop, implement, and ensure compliance with maintenance strategy management, including: Planned maintenance scheduling and compliance with industry standards and manufacturer requirements. Corrective maintenance management and root cause analysis. Planned maintenance task completion and KPI tracking. Annual certification/recertification of attractions rides and devices. Emergency evacuation procedure compliance. Calibration and certification schedules for tools and equipment. Technical team competency development and training management. Spare parts strategy and stock availability. Ride and device modifications in collaboration with manufacturers and IB. Asset management systems and operating module uploads. Ride and device readiness and reliability. Compliance with QHSE policies and sustainability requirements. O&M Manuals, Technical Bulletins, and Service Bulletins management. Development and review of technical documents, SOPs, technical manuals, troubleshooting guides, evacuation procedures, PM checklists, REHAB and NDT schedules. Monthly operational reporting. Develop, forecast, monitor, and achieve operational budgets, including CAPEX and pre-opening expenses. Develop and achieve departmental and company objectives, action plans, and KPIs. People Management Responsibilities Strong communication skills in English; written and spoken Arabic is preferable. Interpersonal, negotiation, and influencing skills. Strong visionary leadership. Strategy implementation and time management skills. Cultural awareness. Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field. Experience Minimum 8 years of experience in the leisure and attraction industry, preferably within theme parks. Familiarity with EN13814 and ASTM F24 ride standards. Experience with attraction rides, wind tunnels, dark rides, climbing walls, e-karting, and playground systems. Proven experience in theme park/FEC ride maintenance and certification processes. Strong knowledge of roller coaster maintenance, rehabilitation, certification, evacuation procedures, and LOTO. Experience with thrill rides, family rides, kiddie rides, climbing walls, and related attraction system

e16e088be60b4319.description: About ASMO ASMO is a joint venture between DHL and Aramco, combining DHL’s logistics expertise with Aramco’s extensive supply chain network. The company aims to establish new standards in procurement and supply chain services. ASMO is scheduled to commence operations in 2025, providing integrated end-to-end procurement and supply chain services to companies across the industrial, energy, chemical, and petrochemical sectors. Initially, the focus will be on Saudi Aramco and its affiliates, with long-term plans to expand to all industrial sectors within Saudi Arabia and the MENA region. The Role of HSE Officer The HSE Officer plays a central role in ensuring the effective implementation of safety measures and fostering a culture of safety, security, and environmental responsibility within ASMO. This full-time position is based in Saudi Arabia and requires 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with the HSE team to implement safety initiatives and programs, ensuring alignment with HSE strategy and objectives. Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant safety laws, regulations, and industry standards, actively managing and mitigating safety-related risks. Assist in the development and implementation of safety policies, procedures, and guidelines to safeguard employees, assets, and the environment. Contribute to the establishment and maintenance of a robust Safety Management System, including risk assessments, incident reporting, investigations, and corrective actions. Support the Head of HSE in overseeing ASMO’s response to incidents, emergencies, and accidents, ensuring timely and effective mitigation. Contribute to sustainability initiatives, aiming to minimize ASMO’s environmental footprint and promote eco-friendly practices. Assist in the development and maintenance of security protocols and crisis management plans to protect personnel, assets, and operations. Collaborate on the development and delivery of comprehensive HSE training programs for employees. Contribute to the tracking and reporting of key HSE performance indicators and metrics, identifying areas for improvement. Engage with internal and external stakeholders, including regulatory agencies, to ensure transparent communication and collaboration on safety, security, and environmental matters. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience relevant to Health, Safety, and Environment roles. The position requires a professional who can effectively implement safety measures and contribute to a secure and environmentally responsible workplace. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Saudi Arabia, working within ASMO’s operational framework to support its strategic objectives in procurement and supply chain services.

e1c08c552ae6a82d.description: We are looking for a driven and commercially minded Sales Account Manager to join our team in Riyadh and help grow Moyasar’s merchant base. This role is focused on new business acquisition, prospecting, and closing deals . You will be responsible for identifying potential merchants, understanding their payment needs, presenting Moyasar’s solutions, and managing the sales cycle from initial contact through closing and onboarding. Key Responsibilities Identify and target prospective merchants across different industries and business sizes. Conduct outbound sales activities through calls, emails, meetings, networking, referrals, and other channels. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified sales opportunities. Research prospective merchants and understand their business and payment requirements. Present and demonstrate Moyasar’s payment solutions to prospective merchants. Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting and qualification through proposal, negotiation, and closing. Conduct regular face to face meetings and visits with prospective merchants. Prepare commercial proposals, presentations, and pricing offers. Negotiate commercial terms and close deals in line with company objectives. Build relationships with business owners, executives, and key decision makers. Achieve assigned sales, merchant acquisition, and transaction volume targets. Maintain accurate records of leads, opportunities, meetings, and follow-ups in the CRM. Monitor competitor activity, market trends, and developments in fintech and payments. Share merchant feedback and market insights with relevant internal teams. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in B2B sales, business development, merchant acquisition, or a similar commercial role. Proven experience in prospecting and outbound sales. Proven experience in negotiating and closing new business. Experience in fintech, payments, banking, e-commerce, SaaS, or financial services is strongly preferred. Good understanding of CRM systems and sales reporting. Ability to build relationships with business owners, executives, and key decision makers. Experience presenting solutions to prospective clients and decision makers. Fluent in Arabic and English. Eligible to work in Saudi Arabia.

e1c26ae91746a459.description: We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer - Checkout to join our engineering team focused on Fintech, Checkout, and Promotions. You will design, build, and scale highly available backend systems that power mission-critical payment experiences, checkout flows, promotions, loyalty, pricing, and financial services. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy solving complex distributed systems problems, building high-performance services, and designing software that operates reliably at scale. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Data, and Engineering teams to deliver resilient, observable, and maintainable systems that directly impact millions of transactions. We value engineers with strong software engineering fundamentals who embrace modern development practices, including leveraging AI to improve engineering productivity, software quality, testing, debugging, and delivery speed. Responsibilities Design, build, and operate scalable backend services supporting Fintech, Checkout, Promotions, Loyalty, and Payment systems. Develop clean, maintainable, and high-performance production code with readability and long-term ownership in mind. Design and evolve RESTful APIs and integrations with internal platforms, payment gateways, and third-party services. Build reliable distributed systems capable of handling high traffic, failures, and asynchronous workloads. Drive architectural decisions with scalability, resilience, maintainability, and operational excellence in mind. Optimize application performance across services, databases, caching layers, queues, and background workers. Participate in architecture discussions, technical design reviews, RFCs, and engineering planning. Ensure services are production-ready through monitoring, logging, alerting, testing, and observability best practices. Write comprehensive unit and integration tests while maintaining high engineering standards through code reviews. Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to accelerate development, debugging, testing, documentation, and code quality. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through technical leadership, design discussions, and engineering best practices. Contribute throughout the full software development lifecycle, from design through deployment and production support. Continuously improve system reliability, developer experience, and engineering standards across the team. 6+ years of professional software engineering experience building production backend systems. Strong experience building scalable backend services in at least one modern language such as PHP, Go, Java, or C#. Experience with PHP and Laravel is preferred but not required. Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency, availability, concurrency, fault tolerance, idempotency, asynchronous processing, messaging, and caching. Experience designing and operating high-scale, highly available backend systems. Proven ability to write clean, maintainable, efficient, and high-performance production code. Strong understanding of software engineering principles, including SOLID, design patterns, clean architecture, and domain-driven design concepts. Experience designing RESTful APIs and integrating with third-party platforms and payment providers. Strong SQL knowledge with experience designing and optimizing MySQL or PostgreSQL databases. Experience with caching technologies, queues, background workers, and performance optimization. Experience writing automated tests, participating in code reviews, and working within modern CI/CD pipelines. Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, software design, implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and code reviews. Preferred Qualifications Experience building Fintech, Payments, Checkout, Loyalty, Pricing, Promotions, or other high-volume transactional systems. Experience with event-driven architectures and distributed messaging systems. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and Infrastructure as Code. Experience with observability platforms, distributed tracing, metrics, and production monitoring. Experience working within microservices or service-oriented architectures. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field is a plus.

e1c042c19b72133c.description: The Senior Director – Distribution is responsible for defining, leading, and optimizing Qiddiya DMO's distribution strategy across all domestic and international sales channels. The role oversees the commercial performance of Qiddiya's distribution ecosystem, including OTAs, GDS platforms, travel trade partners, corporate travel, DMCs, wholesalers, direct booking channels, and emerging digital distribution platforms. The incumbent will drive channel expansion, revenue growth, distribution partnerships, market penetration, and technology enablement while ensuring that Qiddiya's tourism products are effectively distributed, competitively positioned, and commercially optimized across all source markets. The Director will lead a team of distribution professionals and work closely with Revenue Management, Marketing, Technology, Destination Operations, Finance, and external partners to maximize demand generation and conversion. 1. Distribution Strategy & Commercial Leadership Develop and execute Qiddiya's long-term distribution strategy aligned with destination visitation, revenue, and growth objectives. Define channel architecture, market coverage strategy, and distribution priorities across domestic and international markets. Establish distribution frameworks that maximize reach, demand generation, profitability, and customer acquisition. Identify new distribution opportunities, partnerships, and technologies to support business growth. Drive commercial performance across all distribution channels, ensuring revenue targets are achieved. 2. Global Distribution & Channel Development Lead the expansion and management of Qiddiya's global distribution network. Oversee relationships with OTA partners, GDS providers, travel agencies, tour operators, online travel marketplaces, wholesalers, and corporate travel providers. Establish strategic agreements with key distribution partners to increase market penetration. Develop market-specific distribution strategies for priority international source markets. Ensure optimal positioning of Qiddiya products across all booking and sales channels. 3. Trade & Industry Partnerships Develop strategic partnerships with travel trade organizations, DMCs, tourism boards, airlines, hospitality partners, wholesalers, and travel technology providers. Lead commercial negotiations for major distribution agreements and partnership contracts. Establish annual joint business plans with strategic partners. Drive partner engagement initiatives including trade activations, roadshows, educational programs, and industry events. Represent Qiddiya at key travel trade and industry forums. 4. Revenue Optimization & Commercial Performance Own overall distribution revenue performance across all channels. Collaborate closely with Revenue Management to optimize pricing, inventory allocation, and channel mix. Monitor performance trends, booking pace, market demand, and channel productivity. Establish KPIs covering revenue, conversion, acquisition costs, channel contribution, profitability, and market share. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance distribution efficiency and commercial returns. 5. Digital Distribution & Technology Enablement Define the strategic roadmap for distribution technology platforms and capabilities. Oversee Channel Management Systems (CMS), Central Reservation Systems (CRS), booking platforms, and GDS integrations. Drive digital transformation initiatives that improve distribution effectiveness and partner connectivity. Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend investments to enhance commercial performance. Ensure scalability of distribution systems to support destination growth. 6. Governance, Performance Reporting & Insights Establish governance frameworks, policies, and distribution standards. Develop executive dashboards and performance reporting frameworks. Provide regular updates to senior leadership regarding distribution performance, risks, opportunities, and market developments. Utilize market intelligence and competitive analysis to inform strategic decision-making. Ensure compliance with commercial, contractual, and regulatory requirements. 7. Leadership & Organizational Development Build and lead a high-performing Distribution function. Provide leadership, coaching, and development for managers and specialists. Establish workforce and capability plans aligned with future business needs. Foster a culture of accountability, commercial excellence, customer focus, and innovation. Drive continuous improvement across processes, systems, and team performance. Experience Requirements Minimum 12-14 years of experience in Distribution, Commercial Operations, Revenue Management, Tourism, Hospitality, Travel Technology, or related sectors. Minimum 5 years in a senior leadership role with responsibility for distribution strategy and commercial performance. Proven experience managing large-scale distribution ecosystems and channel partnerships. Strong understanding of international travel distribution, OTA management, GDS networks, trade sales, and direct-to-consumer channels. Experience within destination management organizations, hospitality groups, airlines, tourism authorities, theme parks, or integrated resorts is highly desirable. Experience within GCC markets and international tourism source markets preferred. Core Competencies & Skills Distribution Strategy Commercial Leadership Channel Management OTA & Marketplace Management GDS Distribution Trade & Tour Operator Partnerships Revenue Optimization Market Expansion Contract Negotiation

e1fe33d44247dc24.job_title: Reporting Lead - Capital Renewal Program (Saudi Arabia)
e1fe33d44247dc24.description: Eram Talent is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Reporting Lead to manage and drive the reporting activities for the Capital Renewal Program in Saudi Arabia. The Reporting Lead is responsible for overseeing program-wide reporting, analytics, and executive visibility for the Capital Renewal Program at KAUST. This role ensures the delivery of accurate, timely, and actionable insights across all projects, supporting leadership in strategic decision-making, governance, and execution. The role acts as a critical link between project teams and executive management by consolidating data, managing reporting frameworks, and driving continuous improvement in reporting processes, dashboards, and program integration. Lead the design, development, and delivery of regular and ad-hoc reports related to the Capital Renewal Program. Collaborate with project managers, finance, and other stakeholders to define reporting requirements and KPIs. Develop, implement, and maintain standardized reporting frameworks covering scope, cost, schedule, risks, and KPIs, ensuring governance, accuracy, and consistency. Consolidate project data into weekly, monthly, and quarterly executive reports, delivering timely and actionable insights for leadership. Establish and enforce reporting protocols, including timelines, validation workflows, and approval processes across all project teams. Track and manage interdependencies across projects, ensuring alignment with operational priorities and funding cycles. Identify and communicate cross-project risks, delays, and resource conflicts, providing impact assessments and mitigation strategies. Design and maintain executive dashboards, offering real-time visibility into program progress, budget utilization, schedule performance, and key risks. Review and validate master schedules, monitor critical path and dependencies, and proactively address slippages with recovery plans. Drive continuous improvement by enhancing reporting tools, templates, and processes while promoting best practices in planning, scheduling, and program reporting. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business Administration, or related field. Professional certification such as PMP is preferred. Certification in data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) is an advantage. Minimum 7+ years of experience in project reporting, program management, or capital project oversight. Experience in managing reporting frameworks and executive dashboards. Strong understanding of project lifecycle, governance, and reporting processes. Experience in schedule management and critical path analysis. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook) and SAP. Experience with dashboarding and analytics tools. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and mathematical skills.
